text:
Priya: Hey team — new PM (Samir) starts Monday 3/4. Can we put together a concise first-week agenda + a 30/60/90 skeleton I can share with his manager? Need access checklist, 1:1s, and immediate deliverables. Also any required security training? @jen for laptop imaging. :wave:

Marcos: here's a compact agenda I usually send:
- Day 0 (preboard): account + ticketing, Slack, OKR readouts
- Day 1: kickoff with manager, team intros, infra access, PR walkthrough
- Days 2–5: small deliverable + pairing, product context, first stakeholder sync
I also attach a 30/60/90 template (one pager). Use `30-60-90-stub.md` in staff-drive. :+1:

People Ops Bot: Calendar invites created: "Samir — Manager Kickoff" (Mon 10:00), "Team Intros" (Mon 11:00), "Laptop Pickup" (Mon 14:00).

Elena: Heads-up — if Samir needs Dedicated account or prod read-only, file the access request here: https://redwood.atlassian.org/requests/infra-access. Security training (InfoSec Basics) is required within first 3 days — enroll via LMS.

Aisha: Recommend pairing schedule: Day 2 shadow on deployment flow with a teammate, Day 3 hands-on with a small ticket. Assign a buddy (I can be buddy unless we already have one). Also include expectation doc: one measurable outcome by EOW.

Priya: thanks — what should the calendar titles/descriptions be? want them short and copyable.

Marcos: suggested titles/descriptions:
- "Welcome + Manager Kickoff" — 30m. Manager intro, role context, initial priorities.
- "Team Intros" — 45m. Quick rundowns from eng/product/ops.
- "Access & Tools" — 30m. Walkthrough of repos, infra, credentials.
- "First-week Sync (EOW)" — 30m. Review ramp progress + blockers.
You can paste these into invites.

Jen (IT Ops): Laptop imaging scheduled for Mon 9:00–11:00. Samir's device will be enrolled in MDM and SSO; I'll DM tracking number. If they want a Linux dev container, send repo list.

Priya: Perfect. I'll assemble doc and send manager the 30/60/90 stub. @Aisha please confirm buddy. If anyone has a single-sentence EOW outcome template, drop it here. :slightly_smiling_face:

Aisha: EOW outcome template: "By EOW, complete onboarding ticket #123 and demo a basic workflow to your manager." Short and measurable.

People Ops Bot: Checklist status: preboard (accounts) pending, laptop imaging scheduled, calendar invites sent. Use `/onboard status 1712348901` to see details.

Marcos: added a short prompt for PM 30/60/90:
```
30 days: Learn, ship a small bugfix or doc update
60 days: Own a small feature slice and cross-team sync
90 days: Lead a roadmap conversation and own a measurable metric
```

Priya: Thanks all — I'll post final one-pager in #onboarding-templates and ping the hiring manager. :rocket:
